parsed.explanation: Combined regime has no state adult bathroom or care ban, no presentation offence, and municipal protections for 46% of residents, but federal birth-sex facility and passport/entry rules, a document-discrepancy refusal/fraud cable, severe documented immigration and prison custody practices, and no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime enhancement create recurring visitor-facing exposure without reliable statewide remedy. Youth/sports restrictions operate through boards and one school district, not a general adult ban.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal binary sex definition; X-marker passports stopped for new issues Feb 2025, upheld Nov 2025; reported confiscations/blocking. Visa cable orders refusal where documents cast reasonable doubt on sex and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for suspected misrepresentation.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, not automatic, limited waivers possible; passport policy challenged in court.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy at entry can escalate to refusal, added evidence demands, or fraud consideration and possible detention, linking border to custody exposure.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections bureau from 2026 adopted forced hair-cutting, hormone removal and conversion-therapy model; immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. Bureau stopped reporting trans prisoner numbers from 2025; no visitor custody remedy documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Risk is contingent on detention following entry, facility trespass, or other encounter, but consequences if detained are severe and state-run.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. One named school district requires trans students to use birth-sex or private facilities; no statewide adult ban in this division.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Division has no statewide adult public restroom/changing-room ban; four municipalities protect public accommodations; governor's statewide student facility limit failed.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal facility rule applies in federal buildings regardless of state permissiveness; municipal protections do not override federal facilities or entry screening.

care_services.exposure: National orders target gender-affirming care for minors and proposed federal insurance bar; division medical board Aug 2025 recommended restricting under-18 care and approved draft making it unprofessional conduct, not yet operative after vetting/comment.
care_services.protection: No statewide ban on gender-affirming care for adults in division; adult visitor care not barred.
care_services.interaction: For a travelling minor, risk is regulatory uncertainty and board-driven youth policy rather than a documented operative adult-care denial; emergency care practice not documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Government frames gender identity as ideology/extremism: DOJ reward guidance uses 'radical gender ideology'; May 2026 counterterrorism strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' groups; executive orders on pronouns, schools and sports. Poll shows 66% support birth-sex on documents.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No presentation offence, sodomy law repealed 1980, private consensual sex not criminalised; several orders enjoined/challenged; courts have blocked some measures.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State threat-framing increases document scrutiny and institutional hostility but dossier does not document police sweeps, arrests for mere presence, or custody for presentation.

minors_guardians.exposure: State education board barred trans students from female sports Sept 2023; appointed medical board draft would discipline under-18 transition care; one district birth-sex bathroom policy for students.
minors_guardians.protection: Draft youth-care regulation not operative pending law-department review and 30-day comment; no statewide adult facility/care ban.
minors_guardians.interaction: A trans minor visitor is unlikely to enrol, but school, sports or care encounters could trigger district/board rules; parent/guardian has no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination recourse outside four municipalities.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No trans-specific violence count or general homicide rate documented, so no rate comparison can be made. State hate-crime statute does not list gender identity; statewide nondiscrimination law excludes gender identity.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; four municipalities covering 46% of population prohibit gender-identity discrimination in employment, housing and public accommodations.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Outside those municipalities a visitor has no state/municipal recourse for hotel/restaurant discrimination and no state bias enhancement, leaving federal recourse only.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Remedies are patchy and contested: passport and executive-order litigation unresolved; enforcement of four municipal ordinances not sourced; custody, emergency ward, scanner and detention placement for visitors not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have enjoined some national orders and municipal repeal was rejected 53-47 in 2018; civil-liberties suit on passports ongoing.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Litigation may change federal rules during travel but does not currently provide a documented operative remedy for entry, federal facilities, or custody.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than this case on scope: 0.45-A has birth-sex bathrooms in all publicly funded buildings with courts upholding them. Here the division has no statewide adult bathroom ban and only federal facilities plus one school district are restricted, so exposure is narrower.

Similar: recurring border humiliation/questioning partially disciplined, no facility ban, courts/tribunal sometimes compensate, custody unmonitored. This case adds federal facility ban and severe custody reports, but also municipal protections, keeping it near 0.55 rather than 0.65.

Higher than this case: 0.65-C has accepted foreign documents, no facility restriction, dead-letter sexuality law and court compensation, with only custody placement unclear. Here federal document/facility rules are operative and statewide recourse is absent.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime is split: permissive state adult law and municipal pockets versus restrictive federal document, entry and facility rules. A visitor can expect ordinary services in protected municipalities but faces birth-sex federal facilities, possible entry refusal/fraud scrutiny on discrepancy, and no statewide gender-identity service or hate-crime remedy elsewhere. Severe custody harm is documented but contingent on detention; no organised presentation targeting is documented. That combination places the case in elevated risk, above unremedied universal public-building bans and below jurisdictions with no visitor-facing restrictions and working remedies.
